Agent instructions

Source: AGENTS.md

Standing guidance is .cursor/rules/ (Cursor) and .claude/rules/ (Claude Code). The shared rules are also deployed from the ubuntu-genesis bundle at the user level; the levels below explain which copy applies.

Skills and rules: where they live, which one wins

Source of truth: Config/.cursor/ in ubuntu-genesis, cloned to ~/repos/ubuntu-genesis. agent-sync.sh copies it to the user level of both tools.

Level Rules Skills Written by
1. Project .cursor/rules/*.mdc, .claude/rules/*.md .cursor/skills, .claude/skills (none yet) this repository, committed
2. User ~/.cursor/rules, ~/.claude/rules ~/.cursor/skills, ~/.claude/skills agent-sync.sh install-user; do not hand-edit
3. Machine-local none firecrawl*, ~/.agents/skills (npx skills) not vendored, not in git
4. Host built-in none ~/.cursor/skills-cursor, plugins, ~/.claude/skills/synced/ the tool itself

The tools disagree on a name clash, so a name is defined at one level only:

  • Cursor merges rules with the project over the user level (Team, Project, User).
  • Claude Code loads user and project rules together and does not define a winner. For skills of the same name, a personal skill (~/.claude/skills) beats a project skill.
  • Claude Code reads only paths: in a rule’s frontmatter; Cursor reads globs: and alwaysApply:. Bundle rules carry both. A rule without either loads in every session.
  • Claude Code does not read .cursor/ or .agents/.

Project copies in .claude/rules/ and .cursor/rules/ have the same names as bundle rules and may differ from them. Read the project copy as the authority for this repository. Do not add a project skill whose name the bundle already uses.

Keeping the levels in step

  • Edit in the bundle, commit there, git pull; the post-merge hook runs install-user.
  • Edit under ~/.cursor or ~/.claude: the afterFileEdit (Cursor) and PostToolUse (Claude Code) hook, ~/.cursor/hooks/agent-sync-after-edit.sh, runs publish and redeploys. Review git diff in the bundle, then commit.
  • Log: ~/.cache/agent-sync/hook.log. Check: $AGENT_BUNDLE_ROOT/agent-sync/agent-sync.sh verify, or open a shell with CLAUDE_AGENT_SYNC=1 (set in ~/.zshrc; output in verify.log).
  • AGENT_BUNDLE_ROOT is exported in ~/.zshrc and in the env block of ~/.claude/settings.json. Hook shells do not read ~/.zshrc.

Symlinks

  • Do not commit a symlink that leaves the repository (for example .cursor/rules pointing at a bundle outside it): it breaks on clone, in CI and on Windows, and a symlinked skills/ puts every bundle skill at project level. Use copies. A relative link inside the repository is acceptable.
  • ~/.bashrc is a separate file that hands interactive shells to zsh. Do not link it to ~/.zshrc: that file uses zsh-only syntax (setopt, typeset -g).
  • Audit of dtoo_project/ on 2026-11-18: this repository tracks no symlink.

Code graph (graphify)

The graphify rule applies only where graphify-out/ exists, and the folder is not committed. If graphify-out/graph.json is missing, tell the user to run the /graphify skill from the repository root before exploring the code, and wait for the build. Do not substitute a long manual exploration. .graphifyignore already excludes generated and vendored paths (renv/, rendered output, vendored extensions).
